compliance.desc: Consent ladder, opt-out and erasure, quiet hours, retention limits and no auto-sending.
compliance.i1.b: A public signal allows only a public reply. An enquiry allows contact about that listing. Marketing needs explicit opt-in, stored with the wording shown.
compliance.i2.b: Opt-out requests erase the person and keep only a one-way hash so they are not re-ingested.
compliance.i3.b: Calls, SMS and WhatsApp outreach respect UAE-time contact hours (default 09:00 to 20:00). Blocked actions say when they may be retried.
compliance.i4.b: Public-signal leads are purged after 90 days and opted-in leads after 730 days by default. Both are configurable.
compliance.i5.b: Outreach drafts include the agent name, BRN, Trakheesi permit and an opt-out line, and a human approves them.
compliance.i6.b: Connectors must declare a lawful basis. There is no login-wall scraping, fake accounts or rate-limit evasion.
compliance.lead: The product makes the safe path the default. Confirm the details with UAE counsel for your licence type.
compliance.notice: Engineering guidance, not legal advice. Confirm retention, consent wording, calling hours and DNCR handling with UAE counsel (PDPL, TDRA telemarketing rules, DLD and RERA advertising rules).
compliance.title: Compliance

faq.desc: Answers about sources, consent, data, languages and getting started.
faq.i1.b: Meta lead ads, signed form webhooks, portal enquiry emails, the WhatsApp Cloud API, your website widget and CSV uploads. Reddit and licensed-provider connectors are part of the self-hosted single-agency edition.
faq.i2.b: No. That breaches platform terms and UAE data-protection law. Only official APIs, licensed providers and first-party forms are supported.
faq.i2.t: Do you scrape social networks behind a login?
faq.i3.b: No. Drafts are approved by a human. WhatsApp replies go only to people who messaged first, and sending is off by default.
faq.i4.b: Lead understanding works in English and Gulf Arabic. The interface is available in English and Arabic with right-to-left layout.
faq.i5.b: Yes. Each workspace has its own database file and application instance.
faq.i5.t: Is my agency's data separate from other agencies?
faq.i6.b: Yes. The owner invites managers and agents. Agents see only the leads assigned to them.
faq.i7.b: They are configuration with indicative defaults. Verify current rules before quoting a client.
faq.i7.t: What about fees and mortgage rules in the calculators?
faq.i8.b: Create a workspace, confirm your email address, add your agents and projects, then connect a source.

features.desc: Bilingual intent detection, explainable scoring, agent routing, WhatsApp qualification, inventory matching, viewings, ROI by source and more.
features.h1: Everything an agency needs between enquiry and viewing
features.i1.b: Reads English and Gulf Arabic, including diacritics, Arabic-Indic digits and phrases such as 'غرفة وصالة' (1BR) and 'مليون' (million).
features.i10.b: 231 cities in 109 countries with language, currency, time zone and aliases, and free-text city detection in English, Arabic and Russian.
features.i2.b: Recognises 35 communities across 7 emirates with English and Arabic aliases, budgets such as '3-4M' or '800k', bedrooms, off-plan or ready, cash or mortgage, and golden-visa interest.
features.i3.b: Intent, stage, specificity, urgency, financial readiness, source quality and contactability add up to a 0 to 100 score, then decay with age. Every point has a reason.
features.i4.b: Weighted assignment by area, language and capacity. Unanswered HOT and WARM leads are reassigned after their reply target, then flagged for the manager.
features.i5.b: A Cloud API webhook verified by signature. Replies go only to people who messaged first, and sending is off by default. STOP erases the lead.
features.i6.b: Import your project list as CSV. Area is a hard filter, then budget, bedrooms and handover timing. Golden-visa fit uses a threshold you configure.
features.i7.b: Transaction costs, monthly payment, gross and net yield and cash needed. All rates are configuration marked to verify against current rules.
features.i8.b: Overlap detection per agent and automatic lead status updates when a viewing is booked.
features.i9.b: Per-lead tasks with the permitted channel shown, plus cost per lead, per qualified lead and per win by source.
features.lead: Each capability below is part of the product today.
features.title: Features

home.c_body: A public post is never treated as marketing consent. People can opt out at any time, and nothing is sent automatically.
home.desc: Turn public buying and renting intent and your own lead forms into a scored, consent-aware pipeline, routed to the right agent in minutes.
home.f1.b: English and Gulf Arabic. Buyer, investor, renter, seller or landlord, with the evidence phrases behind every decision.
home.f2.b: A 0 to 100 score where every point is attributed, with reply targets of 5 minutes, 1 hour or 24 hours.
home.f3.b: Assignment by area, language and capacity. Unanswered leads are escalated, then flagged to the manager.
home.f4.b: A short Arabic or English flow collects intent, area, budget and timeline, then asks for consent. Sending is off by default.
home.f5.b: Import your own project list. Leads are matched by area, budget, bedrooms and handover timing.
home.f6.b: Overlap-safe viewings per agent, and a daily task list for each agent.
home.final_b: Each agency gets an isolated workspace with its own data, team roles and API key.
home.final_h: Start with a workspace of your own
home.h1: Find buyers and renters early. Follow up the right way.
home.lead: DigitalBurj Leads scores every enquiry in English and Gulf Arabic, explains the score, routes it to an agent and tells the agent what to do next, with consent and opt-outs built in.
home.s1.b: Official APIs, licensed providers and your own forms. Opt-outs are never re-ingested.
home.s2.b: Intent, area, budget and urgency are extracted and scored with the evidence shown.
home.s3.b: The lead goes to an agent with a next step, and outreach respects consent and quiet hours.
home.title: Lead engine for UAE real-estate agencies
how.desc: Five steps from a public signal or form to an assigned, explained and compliant follow-up.
how.h1: From signal to assigned follow-up in five steps
how.i1.b: Use official APIs, licensed providers, signed webhooks, your website widget, portal enquiry emails or a CSV. Every connector declares its lawful basis.
how.i2.b: Anyone who opted out is checked by a one-way hash and is never re-ingested.
how.i3.b: Intent, area, budget, bedrooms and urgency are extracted in English and Gulf Arabic. Noise and broker spam are counted, not stored.
how.i4.b: Identity resolution merges the same person across platforms. The score shows every contribution.
how.i5.b: The lead goes to an agent with a next action, matching projects and a draft that a human approves.
how.title: How it works

privacy.desc: How DigitalBurj Leads handles account data and the lead data agencies process.
privacy.i1.b: For the lead data an agency processes in its workspace, the agency decides why and how it is used and the platform operator processes it on the agency's behalf. For account data (name, email, sign-in records) the operator decides.
privacy.i2.b: Name, email address, a password hash, workspace membership, sign-in and security events, and optional two-factor settings.
privacy.i3.b: Agencies store enquiries, scores and consent evidence in a database isolated per workspace. Retention defaults to 90 days for public signals and 730 days for opted-in leads and is configurable.
privacy.i4.b: Anyone can ask to be erased. We keep only a one-way hash so the person is not re-ingested.
privacy.i5.b: See the Security page for the controls in place. Integration secrets are encrypted at rest.
privacy.i6.b: You may ask to access, correct or delete your personal data. Contact the operator using the details on the Contact page.
privacy.title: Privacy notice
security.desc: Isolated workspaces, hashed passwords, optional two-factor authentication, CSRF protection, encrypted integration secrets and an audit log.
security.i1.b: Each agency has its own database file and application instance. A request routed to one workspace cannot read another's rows.
security.i2.b: Passwords are hashed with scrypt. Sessions use random tokens stored only as hashes, in HttpOnly, SameSite cookies that are Secure over HTTPS.
security.i3.b: Optional authenticator-app codes (TOTP) with single-use recovery codes.
security.i4.b: Progressive lockout, per-address rate limits and identical error messages whether or not an account exists.
security.i5.b: Owner, manager and agent roles. Agents see only the leads assigned to them. Workspace API keys are shown once and stored hashed.
security.i6.b: Integration secrets are encrypted at rest. Sign-ins, consent changes, erasures and key rotations are written to an audit log.
security.lead: These are controls in the product, described plainly. Nothing here replaces your own security review.
security.title: Security
terms.i1.b: DigitalBurj Leads provides software for capturing, qualifying and following up real-estate enquiries. Early-access features may change.
terms.i2.b: Keep your credentials safe. The workspace owner is responsible for the people they invite.
terms.i3.b: You must have a lawful basis for the data you process and must honour opt-outs. You may not use the service for login-wall scraping, fake accounts or unsolicited marketing.
terms.i4.b: You own the data in your workspace. Ask the operator to export or delete it; deleting a workspace removes its database.
terms.i5.b: The service is provided as is during early access, with no uptime commitment. We may update these terms and will tell you about material changes.
terms.i6.b: Calculators and scores are decision aids. Verify fees, rates and rules before quoting a client.
terms.title: Terms of use
